stock.description: Auto Italia Holdings Limited functions as an investment holding entity, cultivating diverse business interests across financial services, life sciences, and real estate investments throughout Hong Kong and Macau. Within its financial sector, the company actively invests in securities while also furnishing financing and corporate finance solutions. Furthermore, its operations encompass the ownership of various properties and strategic capital deployment in the life sciences field. Established in 1989, the firm was formerly known as Wo Kee Hong (Holdings) Limited until its rebranding to Auto Italia Holdings Limited in September 2012. The company's principal place of business is situated in Central, Hong Kong.
